# Clearby Services

> Clearby Services is a Pune-based digital marketing and technology agency helping startups and established businesses grow through performance marketing, custom software engineering, and AI automation.

## Core Capabilities
- **Digital Marketing:** SEO, AEO/GEO, Social Media Marketing, Influencer Marketing, Local SEO.
- **Lead Generation:** Google Ads (PPC), Performance Marketing, WhatsApp/Email/SMS Marketing.
- **Technology & Development:** React.js / Next.js web applications, custom software development, mobile apps.
- **Consulting:** Startup setup advisory and digital transformation strategy.
